body.x: BEOMJUN E&C (CEO Minjoo Yoon) participated in the CES 2023 held in Las Vegas, USA, at the 'Seoul Tech Pavilion' in the Las Vegas Convention Center(LVCC) for a total of 4 days from January 5 (Thursday) to January 8 (Sunday, local time).

BEOMJUN E&C is a company that has been approved by the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, and Transport and leads green growth by developing new technology to reform waste sulfur, an industrial byproduct generated in the petroleum refining process, by utilizing and processing it as an additive for concrete and asphalt.

The modified sulfur cement concrete additive (SU+ C100), which they introduced at the trade show, is a highly functional and eco-friendly cement concrete additive made by using modifiers on sulfur generated as a byproduct of petroleum and gas refining and DCPD discharged as byproducts from petrochemical plants. It has been selected as a national new technology and was awarded the King Sejong Award. The asphalt concrete modifier (SU+ A100), which also showcased, is an eco-friendly modified-sulfur asphalt binder that utilizes sulfur byproducts to improve elasticity.

In addition, BEOMJUN E&C added a substance that absorbs and releases the temperature of the road surface according to the atmospheric environment to a micro sulfur biome product, which is used when roads are being paved to improve the strength of roads, to create an eco-friendly (0% calcium chloride) construction method called PBI (Protect Black Ice), which can be used for long periods of time when used once during construction. It is an eco-friendly construction method that is made by combining porous material and PCM (Phase Change Material) with CMA (Calcium, Magnesium, Acetate) instead of salt and calcium chloride, which are common anti-icing agents. Since it doesn’t freeze even in temperatures reaching -1 to -4 degrees, it can prevent traffic accidents and damages that are caused by black ice.

An official of BEOMJUN E&C said that, “We hope to raise awareness of the importance of the eco-friendly construction industry through the use of high-functioning concrete and asphalt additives, as well publicize the competitiveness of our differentiated products,” and said that, “We will continue R&D by securing more talented personnel in the future.”

‘CES’ is the world’s biggest IT trade show and is a place where one can see the direction and trends of the appliance industry of the entire world. Hosted by the Consumer Technology Association (CTA), it is held annually in Las Vegas, USA in January. Having reported on CES for 17 consecutive years, AVING News started reporting news of CES to the entire world since 2006, and conducted ‘BEST OF CES’, which chose the most innovative product and technology, and ‘BEST OF MADE IN KOREA, which chose the best innovative company in Korea. In addition, it vividly relayed on-site issues in CES through ‘AVING LIVE’.

The Seoul Technology Pavilion operated a Theme Zone which implemented elements of visions for the future and elements for experiences, as well as a Tech Zone which displayed the innovative technology of partnered large corporations and startups. The Seoul Business Agency (SBA) showcased the Seoul Technology Pavilion’s innovative technology in the field of ‘mobility and ESG’ in a large corporation connected open innovation method, and 7 startups possessing innovative technology in the relevant fields will be in participation.
